title: Acceptable
summary: ACCEPT'ABLE, adjective 1. That may be received with pleasure; hence pleasing to a receiver; gratifying; as an acceptable present. 2. Agreeable or pleasing in person; as, a man makes himself acceptable

inlines.v: ACCEPT'ABLE, adjective 1. That may be received with pleasure; hence pleasing to a receiver; gratifying; as an acceptable present. 2. Agreeable or pleasing in person; as, a man makes himself acceptable by his services or civilities.
